capabilities: Send new and edited notes to the Whisperer knowledge base shortly after editing stops
Remove notes from the knowledge base when they are deleted in the vault
Handle renames as moves and run timed full vault re-checks
Exclude folders and non-supported file types from syncing
Run a full resync that compares the vault with the knowledge base and fixes differences
disambiguation: Not a vault sync tool across devices; it only sends notes one-way into the Whisperer service and never writes anything back to the vault.
extras: The vault token is stored in plain text in .obsidian/plugins/whisperer-sync/data.json, so the README warns to exclude it from git or third-party sync; server limits include 1 MB per note, 50 notes and 8 MB per request, and a 100 MB default knowledge-base quota. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is also provided in Russian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to feed vault notes into an external AI assistant's knowledge base.

relations.evidence: Keep your Obsidian vault in sync with your Whisperer knowledge base

summary: One-way sync plugin that sends vault notes to the Whisperer knowledge base so its AI assistant answers from your notes.
